meta.name: ai-act-readiness
meta.description: /cs:ai-act-readiness <system> — EU AI Act 6-question forcing interrogation. Use during AI-system intake, before EU deployment, or during annual compliance refresh as Article 113 obligations phase in (2025-02-02 / 2025-08-02 / 2026-08-02 / 2027-08-02).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI系统是否符合欧盟AI法案要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保AI系统符合欧盟AI法案的合规要求。
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI system compliance with EU AI Act requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your AI system meets EU AI Act obligations.

howto.what: 对上架欧盟的AI系统按欧盟AI法案六问逐条审查,输出就绪报告:判定风险等级(禁止/高风险/有限/最低)、指明合规路径、列出义务与截止期、检查透明度要求,并给出结论与后续行动。
howto.when: 当用户调用 /cs:ai-act-readiness 并提供待审系统信息时触发;典型场景是AI系统上线欧盟前、年度合规刷新或角色变更时。

say.text: 用 /cs:ai-act-readiness 审查我们的客服机器人
say.note: 生成风险分级与合规结论

say.text: 对这套人脸识别系统做 EU AI Act 就绪评估
say.note: 按六问逐条检查并输出报告

say.text: 我们训练算力超过 10^25 FLOPs,评估是否算系统性风险
say.note: 触发 GPAI 与系统性风险条款判断

howto.what_en: Interrogates an AI system against the EU AI Act's six article-based questions and outputs a readiness report: risk tier (prohibited/high/limited/minimal), conformity route, obligation list with deadlines, transparency checks, verdict, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user invokes /cs:ai-act-readiness with a system to assess; typical use cases are pre-EU-deployment intake, annual compliance refresh, or role changes.

say_en.note: Produces risk tier and compliance verdict.

say_en.text: Assess this facial-recognition system for EU AI Act readiness
say_en.note: Runs the six questions and outputs a report.

say_en.text: Our training compute exceeds 10^25 FLOPs; check systemic risk
